intro: The survey takes approximately 4–5 minutes. All responses will be used for academic research.

concept.title: Introducing the Mini Apps concept
paragraphs: Imagine having one platform where you can access services from multiple businesses without downloading a separate application for each business.
For example, you could order food, shop, book appointments, access loyalty programmes and make payments through one integrated platform.
These individual services are called Mini Apps. Similar ecosystems already exist in China through platforms such as WeChat and Alipay.

questions.text: Do you currently live in the Netherlands?
How many different apps or websites do you regularly use for shopping, ordering food, booking services and making payments?
How often do you use digital services such as online shopping, food ordering or appointment booking?
How often do you find it inconvenient to switch between different apps or websites to access services?
What difficulties do you experience when using different apps or websites?
options: Creating separate accounts for different services
Repeatedly entering personal or payment information
Finding the right app or website
I do not experience any difficulties
exclusive: I do not experience any difficulties

questions.text: How much time or effort do you feel you lose managing different apps and websites?
